chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v01] Now who bears the adhikrti here, or how — enough to discriminate, it is said: the various grace-descent order.

[tal-a13-v10] From knowledge karma-destruction, if that — how? From Lord-impulsion, from dharma, if — how? He too — from karma, if that, let it be said.

[tal-a13-v02] There some here say: grace-descent, this method — having shown that, having refuted, own view will be shown.

[tal-a13-v03] There this seen, existent-pleasure-pain-deluded, unequal — existing become thus; posit an equal cause.

[tal-a13-v04] That manifest, insentient various-formed from sattva and the rest — like pot and the rest, an effect, thus; its one cause — that night.

[tal-a13-v05] That inert, effect-formed, effect in her with God indeed — kala-to-earth-ended; from inertia she is unfit for creation.

[tal-a13-v06] By him the Lord would agitate her; her agitation is birth-fitness — toward man, and she produces enjoyable sounds, various kinds.

[tal-a13-v07] Of person in non-distinctness, toward liberated souls, why not that cause? Karma-impression — and it in them is not found.

[tal-a13-v08] Thus if their karma-impression-absence — whence indeed? Not from enjoyment-other-karma-portion involvement, for hard to cross.

[tal-a13-v09] Simultaneous actions' enjoyment is not fitting; by sequence indeed — of which action the fruit? Therefore why would own form sometimes abandon?
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-:C13 atha śrītantrāloke trayodaśamāhnikam athādhikṛtibhāhanaṃ ka iha vā kathaṃ vetyalaṃ vivecayitumucyate vividhaśaktipātakramaḥ tatra kecidiha prāhuḥ śaktipāta imaṃ vidhim / taṃ pradarśya nirākṛtya svamataṃ darśayiṣyate tatredaṃ dṛśyamānaṃ satsukhaduḥkhavimohabhāk / viṣamaṃ sattathābhūtaṃ samaṃ hetuṃ prakalpayet so@vyaktaṃ tacca sattvādinānārūpamacetanam / ghaṭādivatkāryamiti hetureko@sya sā niśā sā jaḍā kāryatādrūpyātkāryaṃ cāsyāṃ sadeva hi / kalādidharaṇīprāntaṃ jāḍyātsā sūtaye@kṣamā teneśaḥ kṣobhayedenāṃ kṣobho@syāḥ sūtiyogyatā / puṃsaḥ prati ca sā bhogyaṃ sūte@nādīn pṛthagvidhān puṃsaśca nirviśeṣatve muktāṇūn prati kiṃ na tat / nimittaṃ karmasaṃskāraḥ sa ca teṣu na vidyate iti cetkarmasaṃskārābhāvasteṣāṃ kutaḥ kila / na bhogādanyakarmāṃśaprasaṅgo hi duratyayaḥ yugapatkarmaṇāṃ bhogo naca yuktaḥ krameṇa hi / phaledyatkarma tatkasmātsvaṃ rūpaṃ saṃtyajetkvacit jñānātkarmakṣayaścettatkuta īśvaracoditāt / dharmādyadi kutaḥ so@pi karmataścettaducyatām

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v11] No karma is such that knowledge arises by it — and karma-born, that knowledge in fruit-heap falls certainly.

[tal-a13-v12] Other-karma fruit, former karma-mass — what would burn? Of the Lord, even devoid of hatred-attachment, how ever?

[tal-a13-v13] Thus intention, not elsewhere, from absence of difference-cause — but thus knowledge would burn karma-nets; karma indeed.

[tal-a13-v14] Ignorance-cooperating this produces heaven-and-rest fruit — ignorance from knowledge perishes, also from other-karma fruit.

[tal-a13-v15] Fasting and the rest, and other evil-karma fruit may be — renders fruitless the evil, accepted as karma indeed.

[tal-a13-v16] Ignorance thus, what is said: if knowledge-absence — what then? Prior absence or destruction; in the first, what of all cognitions?

[tal-a13-v17] Of anyone, or then, knowledge — the eastern thesis is impossible: not one whose knowledge arose such-like.

[tal-a13-v18] Not even an atom exists in existence, indeed in this beginningless — what now this order? Of future, prior-absence of knowledge, established being.

[tal-a13-v19] Of the liberated atom too, he is indeed from birth; before, this one — and not knowledge future, when liberated in this — if discussed, this.

[tal-a13-v20] Why knowledge not to be here — indeed from body-and-rest birth? Therefore why from karma depletion — whence knowledge-loss?
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-nahi karmāsti tādṛkṣaṃ yena jñānaṃ pravartate / karmajatve ca tajjñānaṃ phalarāśau pateddhruvam anyakarmaphalaṃ prācyaṃ karmarāśiṃ ca kiṃ dahet / īśasya dveṣarāgādiśūnyasyāpi kathaṃ kvacit tathābhisaṃdhirnānyatra bhedahetorabhāvataḥ / nanvitthaṃ pradahejjñānaṃ karmajālāni karma hi ajñānasahakārīdaṃ sūte svargādikaṃ phalam / ajñānaṃ jñānato naśyedanyakarmaphalādapi upavāsādikaṃ cānyadduṣṭakarmaphalaṃ bhavet / niṣphalīkurute duṣṭaṃ karmetyaṅgīkṛtaṃ kila ajñānamiti yatproktaṃ jñānābhāvaḥ sa cetsa kim / prāgabhāvo@thavā dhvaṃsa ādye kiṃ sarvasaṃvidām kasyāpi vātha jñānasya prācyaḥ pakṣastvasaṃbhavī / na kiṃcidyasya vijñānamudapādi tathāvidhaḥ nāṇurasti bhave hyasminnanādau ko@nvayaṃ kramaḥ / bhāvinaḥ prāgabhāvaśca jñānasyeti sthite sati muktāṇorapi so@styeva janmataḥ prāgasau naca / jñānaṃ bhāvi vimukte@sminniti ceccarcyatāmidam kasmājjñānaṃ na bhāvyatra nanu dehādyajanmataḥ / tatkasmātkarmaṇaḥ kṣaiṇyāttatkuto@jñānahānitaḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v21] Of ignorance, how loss — in prior absence indeed of consciousness? Ignorance is that prior absence — not, from impossibility of future production.

[tal-a13-v22] Why not future that knowledge — indeed from body-and-rest birth? Thus this all-party-destroyer, sharp-wheel whirling.

[tal-a13-v23] Now destruction indeed is this ignorance, situated always — in liberated atoms thus; in them let Maya-effect expansion be.

[tal-a13-v24] Now ignorance is not non-existence but false knowledge — their view; that very, of actions in own duty, is co-cause.

[tal-a13-v25] What action should be declared, when it produces its own fruit, if causality is obtained only through false knowledge?

[tal-a13-v26] Now, if false knowledge is truly present at the moment action is performed, what fruit comes from such action?

[tal-a13-v27] In the prior view, after dissolution and at the beginning of creation, false knowledge has no possibility anywhere because body and the rest are absent.

[tal-a13-v28] In the latter view, whenever and wherever action is done, all of it is accompanied by ignorance.

[tal-a13-v29] Necessarily, for anyone, destruction of karma would not occur, even if, having become a knower, one performs some action.

[tal-a13-v30] Action would be fruitless, but what course remains for the prior mass of karma, even at dissolution, through union with conscious nature?
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-ajñānasya kathaṃ hāniḥ prāgabhāve hi saṃvidaḥ / ajñānaṃ prāgabhāvo@sau na bhāvyutpattyasaṃbhavāt kasmānna bhāvi tajjñānaṃ nanu dehādyajanmataḥ / ityeṣa sarvapakṣaghno niśitaścakrakabhramaḥ atha pradhvaṃsa evedamajñānaṃ tatsadā sthitam / muktāṇuṣviti teṣvastu māyākāryavijṛmbhitam athājñānaṃ nahyabhāvo mithyājñānaṃ tu tanmatam / tadeva karmaṇāṃ svasminkartavye sahakāraṇam vaktavyaṃ tarhi kiṃ karma yadā sūte svakaṃ phalam / tadaiva mithyājñānena satā hetutvamāpyate atha yasminkṣaṇe karma kṛtaṃ tatra svarūpasat / mithyājñānaṃ yadi tatastādṛśātkamarṇaḥ phalam prākpakṣe pralaye vṛtte prācyasṛṣṭipravartane / dehādyabhāvānno mithyājñānasya kvāpi saṃbhavaḥ uttarasminpunaḥ pakṣe yadā yadyena yatra vā / kriyate karma tatsarvamajñānasacivaṃ tadā avaśyamiti kasyāpi na karmaprakṣayo bhavet / yadyapi jñānavānbhūtvā vidhatte karma kiṃcana viphalaṃ syāttu tatpūrvakarmarāśau tu kā gatiḥ / atha pralayakāle @pi citsvabhāvatvayogataḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v31] Knowledge arises indeed from atoms as false; whence from nature? Not so in liberated Shiva.

[tal-a13-v32] That which is called non-seeing is the cause in transforming primal matter, indeed from the mixture of both distinctnesses.

[tal-a13-v33] For seeing, beginning with intellect accompanied by fitness for human aim, up to earth, there is whatever arises from mind.

[tal-a13-v34] Experience, called that, is non-distinction of intellect function, from grace of personal effort and manifestation of intellect with object.

[tal-a13-v35] Intellect itself I am; but another having modification nature, different from me, is indeed in whose consciousness?

[tal-a13-v36] Because human aim is accomplished and the cooperator is separated, it does not produce toward that person, but indeed another.

[tal-a13-v37] Here, the root nature of a person is seeing, or one of two; let this alternative be spoken.

[tal-a13-v38] Experience extends up to discrimination; there, what is the limit if all is seen? That too, what?

[tal-a13-v39] Generally or by particulars, in the prior view it would be from one birth; in the latter view, never, by union of future time.

[tal-a13-v40] If by some particulars all become simultaneous, discrimination from beginningless union would leave what mutual variety?
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-aṇūnā saṃbhavatyeva jñānaṃ mithyeti tatkutaḥ / svabhāvāditi cenmukte śive vā kiṃ tathā nahi yaccādarśanamākhyātaṃ nimittaṃ pariṇāmini / pradhāne taddhi saṃkīrṇavaivittayobhayayogataḥ darśanāya pumarthaikayogyatāsacivaṃ dhiyaḥ / ārabhya sate dharaṇīparyantaṃ tatra yaccitaḥ buddhivṛttyaviśiṣṭatvaṃ puṃsprayāśarprasādataḥ / prakāśanāddhiyo@rthena saha bhogaḥ sa bhaṇyate buddhirevāsmi vikṛtidharmikānyastu ko@pyasau / madvilakṣaṇa ekātmetyevaṃ vaivi yasaṃvidi pumarthasya kṛtatvena sahakāriviyogataḥ / taṃ pumāṃsaṃ prati naiva sūte kiṃtvanyameva hi atra puṃso@tha mūlasya dharmo@darśanatā dvayoḥ / athaveti vikalpo@yamāstāmetattu bhaṇyatām bhogo vivekaparyanta iti yattatra ko@vadhiḥ / vivekalābhe nikhilasūtidṛgyadi sāpi kim sāmānyena viśeṣairvā prācye syādekajanmataḥ / uttare na kadācitsyādbhāvikālasya yogataḥ kaiścideva viśeṣaiścetsarveṣāṃ yugapadbhavet / viveko@nādisaṃyogātkā hyanyonyaṃ vicitratā

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v41] Therefore, even by Samkhya view, this ignorance is not fitted; without ignorance, bondage and liberation have no order.

[tal-a13-v42] They are fitted, but that is not established by stated reasons, even if fear, action, and gods' will exist.

[tal-a13-v43] There is no union of bondage and liberation because a difference cause is impossible; therefore by the word ignorance, knowership and agency natures are meant.

[tal-a13-v44] The covering of conscious atoms is something to be spoken by the wise, established as covering nature, non-different from its own form.

[tal-a13-v45] In difference and absence of proof, that one in all selves; whence is it produced? If from maya, how indeed is that?

[tal-a13-v46] Somewhere only, well-traversed not this; in liberated self thus this prior further question: would a cause be obtained if not?

[tal-a13-v47] From absence of origination by that, it is eternal and does not perish; from that, in oneness only, and from commonality of other self.

[tal-a13-v48] Not from being cause of a real thing, not from concealment of mind, and not union of selves by this self, because of its impossibility.

[tal-a13-v49] Therefore one thing, always bound with selves, inert impurity, that ignorance, is the cause of samsara's sprout.

[tal-a13-v50] When its obstructing power rests, by Shiva's rays the soul is touched, and its own knowledge and action become clear.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-tasmātsāṃkhyadṛśāpīdamajñānaṃ naiva yujyate / ajñānena vinā bandhamokṣau naiva vyavasthayā yujyete tacca kathitayuktibhirnopapadyate / bhāyākarmāṇudevecchāsadbhāve@pi sthite tataḥ na bandhamokṣayoryogo bhedahetorasaṃbhavāt / tasmādajñānaśabdena jñatvakartṛtvadharmaṇām cidaṇūnāmāvaraṇaṃ kiṃcidvācyaṃ vipaścitā / āvāraṇātmanā siddhaṃ tatsvarūpādabhedavat bhede pramāṇābhāvācca tadekaṃ nikhilātmasu / tacca kasmātprasūtaṃ syānmāyātaścetkathaṃ nu sā kvacideva suvītaitanna tu muktātmanītyayam / prācyaḥ paryanuyogaḥ syānnimittaṃ cenna labhyate utpattyabhāvatastena nityaṃ naca vinaśyati / tata evaikatāyāṃ cānyātmasādhāraṇatvataḥ na vāvastvarthakāritvānna cittatsaṃvṛtitvataḥ / na caitenātmanāṃ yogo hetumāṃstadasaṃbhavāt tenaikaṃ vastu sannityaṃ nityasaṃbaddhamātmabhiḥ / jaḍaṃ malaṃ tadajñānaṃ saṃsārāṅkurakāraṇam tasya roddhrī yadā śaktirudāste śivaraśmibhiḥ / tadāṇuḥ spṛśyate spṛṣṭaḥ svake jñānakriye sphuṭe

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v51] This soul enters, like a sunstone by a ray, impelled, through the graded mediation of the obstructing power.

[tal-a13-v52] Therefore they call variety in manifestation of self-awareness; this is defined in scriptures as descent of power.

[tal-a13-v53] Here it is said that impurity thus is not fitting; what fruit is there in repeating what was stated earlier?

[tal-a13-v54] What is the ripening of impurity? If destruction of other selves, then calling that one impurity attaches purity.

[tal-a13-v55] Now impurity, per soul and beginningless like prior absence, would perish; yet this destruction must be caused.

[tal-a13-v56] The cause is karma or the lord's will; karma is not such, and the lord's free will is only sometimes; so what then?

[tal-a13-v57] If its destruction is uncaused, then it already perishes; after a moment similar production follows; if so, only steadiness remains.

[tal-a13-v58] Destruction is not seen for eternal being whose birth is not cause-dependent; prior absence is nonexistent, so be it.

[tal-a13-v59] Now its ripening is named boundness to own power toward all; so it would be obstructed power, like poison-fire.

[tal-a13-v60] If power arises again, its own effect would arise like poison-fire; even liberated ones would not be liberated; we do not accept its power.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-samāviśedayaṃ sūryakānto@rkeṇeva coditaḥ / roddhryāśca śaktermādhyasthyatāratamyavaśakramāat vicitratvamataḥ prāhurabhivyaktau svasaṃvidaḥ / sa eṣa śaktipātākhyaḥ śāstreṣu paribhāṣyate atrocyate malastāvaditthameṣa na yujyate / iti pūrvāhṇike proktaṃ punaruktau tu kiṃ phalam malasya pākaḥ ko @yaṃ syānnāśaśceditarātmanām / sa eko mala ityukternairmalyamanuṣajyate atha pratyātmaniyato@nādiśca prāgabhāvavat / malo naśyettathāpyeṣa nāśo yadi sahetukaḥ hetuḥ karmeśvarecchā vā karma tāvanna tādṛśam / īśvarecchā svatantrā ca kvacideva tathaiva kim ahetuko@sya nāśaścetprāgevaiṣa vinaśyatu / kṣaṇāntaraṃ sadṛk sūte iti cetsthirataiva sā na ca nityasya bhāvasya hetvanāyattajanmanaḥ / nāśo dṛṣṭaḥ prāgabhāvastvavastviti tathāstu saḥ athāsya pāko nāmaiṣa svaśaktipratibaddhatā / sarvānprati tathaiṣa syādruddhaśaktirviṣāgnivat punarudbhūtaśaktau ca svakāryaṃ syādviṣāgnivat / muktā api na muktāḥ syuḥ śaktiṃ cāsya na manmahe

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v61] If obstruction is mere existence of knowledge and agency, then possibility of Shiva-liberated soul is compromised.

[tal-a13-v62] Impurity does nothing beyond proximity; by itself changeability would imply impermanence.

[tal-a13-v63] Souls are not dependent on knowledge and agency only; if that is obstructed, alas, destruction of form follows.

[tal-a13-v64] Covering is invisibility, and it does not make otherness of that thing; knowledge like a pot cannot be covered.

[tal-a13-v65] How is that same covering not known by coverable knowledge? Otherwise covering would be name only.

[tal-a13-v66] Who is the obstacle to the obstructing power? The lord; if without dependence, the previously given answer applies.

[tal-a13-v67] Considering equality of karma, its will proceeds; its form must be stated; what equality of karmas indeed?

[tal-a13-v68] By greatness of enjoyment cycle in time, toward some fruit, from opposition karmas obstructed and standing, such equality arises.

[tal-a13-v69] The all-knowing god, having seen that time-portion, obstructs that impurity; that time is marked by avoiding pleasure, pain, and so on.

[tal-a13-v70] Not by sequential pure or mixed form karmas; so too in own fruit to be given, what is this mutual obstruction?
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-roddhrīti cetkasya nṛṇāṃ jñatvakartṛtvayoryadi / sadbhāvamātrādroddhṛtve śivamuktāṇvasaṃbhavaḥ saṃnidhānātiriktaṃ ca na kiṃcitkurute malaḥ / ātmanā pariṇāmitvādanityatvaprasaṅgataḥ jñatvakartṛtvamātraṃ ca pudgalā na tadāśrayāḥ / taccedāvāritaṃ hanta rūpanāśaḥ prasajyate āvāraṇaṃ cādṛśyatvaṃ na ca tadvastuno@nyatām / karoti ghaṭavajjñānaṃ nāvarītuṃ ca śakyate jñānenāvaraṇīyena tadevāvaraṇaṃ katham / na jñāyate tathā ca syādāvṛtirnāmamātrataḥ roddhryāśca śakteḥ kastasya pratibandhaka īśvaraḥ / yadyapekṣāvirahitastatra prāgdattamuttaram karmasāmyamapekṣyātha tasyecchā saṃpravartate / tasyāpi rūpaṃ vaktavyaṃ samatā karmaṇāṃ hi kā bhogaparyāyamāhātmyātkāle kvāpi phalaṃ prati / virodhātkarmaṇī ruddhe tiṣṭhataḥ sāmyamīdṛśam taṃ ca kālāṃśakaṃ devaḥ sarvajño vīkṣya taṃ malam / runddhe lakṣyaḥ sa kālaśca sukhaduḥkhādivarjanaiḥ naitatkramikasaṃśuddhavyāmiśrākārakarmabhiḥ / tathaiva deye svaphale keyamanyonyaroddhṛtā

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v71] If both are obstructed, birth and lifespan would not be; therefore the body would fall; if cessation is only of enjoyments, indeed?

[tal-a13-v72] If Shankara obstructs impurity in presence of karma giving birth and lifespan, what does he fear from enjoyment-giving karma?

[tal-a13-v73] Even gathering hundreds of states free from heat and cold, devotion-rasa immersion is not seen in abundance.

[tal-a13-v74] Even so, considering the greatness of time, the supreme lord acts thus; what kind is that time?

[tal-a13-v75] What of this beginningless enjoyment and beginningless karma with person? Hence enjoyment-cycle time is unequalled for all.

[tal-a13-v76] If there were a beginning for someone, variety would arise from that class; enjoyed by this and by this aeon, but the pair.

[tal-a13-v77] From so much enjoyment cycle there would be equality of karmas; by this method-seed I think the cause of variety.

[tal-a13-v78] The world's fixed karma does not fit thus; atoms covered by beginningless impurity are cognition-action-self.

[tal-a13-v79] How are all equal yet resort to variegated karma succession by enjoyment craving? Variegated indeed, whence?

[tal-a13-v80] If again beginningless karma impression variety is to be said, that same variety, whence of necessity and attachment?
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-rodhe tayośca jātyāyurapi na syādataḥ patet / deho bhogadayoreva nirodha iti cennanu jātyāyuṣpradakarmāṃśasaṃnidhau yadi śaṃkaraḥ / malaṃ runddhe bhogadātuḥ karmaṇaḥ kiṃ bibheti saḥ śataśo@pi hlādatāpaśūnyāṃ saṃcinvate daśām / na ca bhaktirasāveśamiti bhūmnā vilokitam athāpi kālamāhātmyamapekṣya parameśvaraḥ / tathā karoti vaktavyaṃ kālo@sau kīdṛśastviti kiṃ cānādirayaṃ bhogaḥ karmānādi sapudgalam / tataśca bhogaparyāyakālaḥ sarvasya niḥsamaḥ ādimattve hi kasyāpi vargādasmādbhavediyam / vaicitrī bhuktametena kalpametena tu dvayam iyato bhogaparyāyātsyātsāmyaṃ karmaṇāmiti / anena nayabījena manye vaicitryakāraṇam jagataḥ karma yatklaptaṃ tattathā nāvakalpate / anādimalasaṃcchannā aṇavo dṛkkriyātmanā sarve tulyāḥ kathaṃ citrāṃ śritāḥ karmaparamparām / bhogalolikayā cetsā vicitreti kuto nanu anādi karmasaṃskāravaicitryāditi cetpunaḥ / vācyaṃ tadeva vaicitryaṃ kuto niyatirāgayoḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v81] If this greatness, why are those two not inconsistent sharers? But independence from lord's will is not a possible cause of difference.

[tal-a13-v82] By beginninglessness alone, reasonless, impurity of order is proved; then let it be by impurity, vain by this.

[tal-a13-v83] For thus karma lasts not until maya is active in person; and cause, its course, that measured impurity.

[tal-a13-v84] Thus and in assumed maya-effect in karma, causality; if beginningless karma goes, what of assumption of impurity?

[tal-a13-v85] Surely may there be no impurity then — in variegated forms, in continuously revolving acts, order is not established.

[tal-a13-v86] At first, in the middle, from action-variety — not as equal; even self-form, some this, in future time would be so.

[tal-a13-v87] Thus cut off indeed is this bondage-liberation-etc. course — bondage from ignorance, liberation from knowledge, thus examined.

[tal-a13-v88] In opposition, self-fruited, these two karmas, at some time — if neutralized, then let this karma be awakened.

[tal-a13-v89] Of Shiva-power descent, what room, by that much — somewhere, at a time, when of those two this indifference, then?

[tal-a13-v90] In another time, from non-cessation of such opposition — and therefore at fruit-end not, by those two, and other karmas.

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v100] Thus considered, if of the Lord — and this refutable, as before; and deviation by universality-particularity, from own nature.

[tal-a13-v97] By this, others too, to be examined, posited in Lord's will — they too are destroyed, from eternal-causeless-beginning refutation.

[tal-a13-v99] Calamity-arrival watching, in body some mark — scripture-service, enjoyment-group fullness, lordly knowledge.

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v101] Mutual non-entry and impossibility, the more — therefore we do not think: who is this, of grace-descent order, the order?

[tal-a13-v103] Lord, free consciousness-formed, light-self, by nature — by form-concealment-play-yoga, atomic, manifold.

[tal-a13-v104] He himself, by imagined-form-conceptual acts, binds himself here indeed — from freedom, so described.

[tal-a13-v105] Freedom-greatness indeed this of the Lord, because that one again — own thoroughly-pure form, touching reality though atomic.

[tal-a13-v106] Not to be said, but how, named, in some man thus — not indeed a name, some man in whom questioned.

[tal-a13-v107] God indeed, so that one, if his own form such — of such-manifestation nature, in nature what suitability?

[tal-a13-v108] Says our supreme lord, and in Shiva-view, the supreme teacher — five-kinds-action-statement Shiva-nature for own action.

[tal-a13-v109] Of the proceeded, other causes — where seeking? In concealed-true-nature appearance, in person, whatever fruit.

[tal-a13-v110] There, of the existing atom, freedom indeed is, from karma — that, and the Lord's which self-conceal-wish, causality.

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v111] It approaches: karma-mala-hence-non-divine-establishment; concealment is full-form's incompleteness, and that is filling.

[tal-a13-v112] Towards, by distinct state, desired — foolish impurity, without pure-self-luminous-self Shiva-nature.

[tal-a13-v113] Not anything is joined by that; cause here is the great Lord — thus in creation-preservation-destruction triad he depends on Maya.

[tal-a13-v114] For action, impurity and karma, as Shiva-will alone — well established; but in whatever Shiva by own form shines.

[tal-a13-v115] There his, not in atom, so-long dependent — mala and karma, in atomic-nature loss, gone-into-that, causality — how?

[tal-a13-v116] Go Maya-independence — therefore establish thus; thereby pure self-luminous Shiva indeed here is cause.

[tal-a13-v117] He, by mere free will, gradation-revealer — clan-birth-body-action-age-observance abundance.

[tal-a13-v118] Regardless, in Shiva devotion — grace-descent of fruit-seekers; which by fruit-desire, devotion depends on karma and the rest.

[tal-a13-v119] Then there would be in fruit difference, not in liberation — but that one thus, of the both-enjoyment-liberation aimer also, clearly.

[tal-a13-v120] In prior part looks karma, from wonder, not later, again — even unilluminated form, by that illumination only, that.

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v121] Having stood and gathered mantra and so forth, he would abandon his concealment; the blessed one declared this in the Sri Sara Shastra.

[tal-a13-v122] He wraps himself, without doubt, in many states made of dharma and adharma, from avicya to the end of shiva.

[tal-a13-v123] By a group of powers like that, he indeed wraps himself; the lord of gods binds and also releases himself.

[tal-a13-v124] He himself is enjoyer, knower, and marker; enjoyment and liberation are himself; the goddess and lord are himself.

[tal-a13-v125] He himself is the one syllable; as heat of the black path, the thing spoken here is manifestation of self-form by freedom.

[tal-a13-v126] In Sri Nishakula it is also said: small-minded ones with falsely imagined minds suffer by examining impurity and illusion.

[tal-a13-v127] Dear one, what can dust do to crystal? As blue in the sky, abandon suspicion of impurity from that.

[tal-a13-v128] The glorious knowledge teacher said: in view of proof and praise, at the time of destruction of dharma-adharma pervasion, descent of power is accepted by those who conceal.

[tal-a13-v129] Agreeing by own will, hymns and so forth would declare freedom independent of principles; gradation manifests as intense, moderate, and mild.

[tal-a13-v130] Those indeed are each of descent of power, established in threefold; intense-intense descent of power occurs by fall of body itself.

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v131] Liberation-giving at that time or other; by gradation, from moderate-intense again all ignorance turns away.

[tal-a13-v132] Because he himself knows selfhood as bondage and liberation, that intuitive great knowledge is independent of scripture and teacher.

[tal-a13-v133] Intuition-moonlight quiets darkness, and the teacher-moon destroys darkness and heat, opening bliss-filled sight.

[tal-a13-v134] He is disciple from doership; another is disciple from action-state; everywhere in smarta status, time, family, and so forth.

[tal-a13-v135] The self-born, established in scripture meaning and intuition, is said; by that rooted instruction no creature is empty.

[tal-a13-v136] Even there, gradation-born infinity; firmness awaits reasoning, scripture, teacher speech, practice, and so forth.

[tal-a13-v137] Shaking knowledge indeed returns again itself; firmness of another comes by reasoning and so forth by others alone.

[tal-a13-v138] As less dependence on others may be in intuition, so that teacher is best, gone beyond knowledge.

[tal-a13-v139] Even learned infinite knowledge from elsewhere; by power of intuition, what he knows there, that shivahood is greater.

[tal-a13-v140] For him, order of initiation and so forth is not, nor consecration, nor lineage and so forth, nor vow of knowledge on the intuitive path.

[tal-a13-v141] The primordial knower great god is established by that; because purifications are for establishment accomplishment, that is by itself.

[tal-a13-v143] From teacher, austerity, mantra, and so forth, he should arrange his own purification; because it is said in Vajasineya, he should sprinkle the body himself.

[tal-a13-v148] The glory of necessity does not turn back from an achievable result; consecrated by him and practicing vow, he gives fruit.

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v151] In its absence that brought knowledge is honored; thus who knows in truth, for him is liberation-leading.

[tal-a13-v152] Initiation becomes undoubted, without sesame and ghee offerings; even with unseen circle, whoever knows truth.

[tal-a13-v155] The means of knowledge is initiation and rites for those lacking knowledge; this is now set aside in its own discussion.

[tal-a13-v156] Means of guru, scripture, authority and so on are clearly means; intuition is supreme indeed, yielding all desires, because.

[tal-a13-v157] From means and yoga sequence, without means and sequence, which form is supreme truth, well established there.

[tal-a13-v158] Who is beautiful with intuitive external and internal purification, said not serving others, therefore he is direct boon-giving teacher.

[tal-a13-v159] For anyone's own liberation only, until world liberation, intuition arises like firefly, gem, star, moon, sun.

[tal-a13-v160] Then for intuitive awareness this scripture made by us; whoever practices it is not indeed a teacher, for things are imitators.

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v161] With mind living on others all thus does not shine; without its statement one does not know grace descent from weakness.

[tal-a13-v162] This is clear and explained in those scriptures; in Kirana thus said from teacher, scripture, and self.

[tal-a13-v163] Some are fit for knowledge, thus others fit for practice; in Nandishikha tantra this is expounded in detail.

[tal-a13-v164] By question-answer mode that unbroken is explained; indescribable Shiva there, what means let be explained.

[tal-a13-v165] Thus when question was made by goddess, glorious Shambhu explained: means here is discrimination alone, removing what is to be rejected.

[tal-a13-v166] He gives intuitive supreme knowledge; when endowed by intuition, then liberated and liberates others.

[tal-a13-v167] By descent of supreme power person's maya impurity is destroyed; prior initiation liberation now, but how from intuition?

[tal-a13-v168] Thus when question was made by goddess, lord's speech proceeded: creature is liberated by initiation and by intuition, dear one.

[tal-a13-v169] Initiation depends on the guru; its intuitive nature is his own nature, which grants the isolated state.

[tal-a13-v170] Liberation of the isolated one is certain by the supreme principle; the three principles are named for you.

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v171] Power is not bound in bondage; Shiva touches agency, and all this is stated from the guru tradition.

[tal-a13-v172] Again discrimination is stated; explain it further: how is discrimination, and what is discriminated, O god of gods?

[tal-a13-v173] Thus spoken, the primal guru Shiva spoke the three principles from the guru tradition.

[tal-a13-v174] By higher words the accomplished intuitive state is attained by one cultivated through initiation.

[tal-a13-v175] The principle approaches the intuitive; it is illustrated like fire covered by ashes, from the guru tradition.

[tal-a13-v176] As a seed grows when sown and watered, so intuitive knowledge becomes clear through the guru's yoga, rite, and chant.

[tal-a13-v177] When discrimination beyond the senses comes, knowledge of bound soul, bond, and lord shines forth by itself.

[tal-a13-v178] When intuition arrives, other knowledge is sense-based, reachable by speech, eye, and ear, and dependent on another, O fair-faced one.

[tal-a13-v179] Abandon that, taking the intellect; as a lamp by day, when discrimination manifests it is within consciousness.

[tal-a13-v180] Varied play of growth; but from discrimination of all states one turns away from all states.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-nā badhyo bandhane śaktiḥ karaṇaṃ kartṛtāṃ spṛśat / śivaḥ karteti tatproktaṃ sarvaṃ gurvāgamādaṇoḥ punarvivekāduktaṃ taduttarottaramucyatām / kathaṃ vivekaḥ kiṃ vāsya devadeva vivicyate ityukte parameśānyā jagādādiguruḥ śivaḥ / śivāditattvatritayaṃ tadāgamavaśādguroḥ adhrottaragairvākyaiḥ siddhaṃ prātibhatāṃ vrajet / dīkṣāsicchinnapāśatvādbhāvanābhāvitasya hi vikāsaṃ tattvamāyāti prātibhaṃ tadudāhṛtam / bhasmacchannāgnivatsphauṭyaṃ prātibhe gauravāgamāt bījaṃ kāloptasaṃsiktaṃ yathā vardheta tattathā / yogayāgajapairuktairguruṇā prātibhaṃ sphuṭet viveko@tīndriyastveṣa yadāyāti vivecanam / paśupāśapatijñānaṃ svayaṃ nirbhāsate tadā prātibhe tu samāyāte jñānamanyattu sendriyam / vāgakṣiśrutigamyaṃ cāpyanyāpekṣaṃ varānane tattyajedbuddhimāsthāya pradīpaṃ tu yathā divā / prādurbhūtavivekasya syāccidindriyagocare dūrācchrutyādivedhādivṛddhikrīḍāvicitritā / sarvabhāvavivekāttu sarvabhāvaparāṅmukhaḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v181] In plays the well-detached self, filled with Shiva nature, has the greatness of intuition prescribed.

[tal-a13-v182] Seeing Shiva within and without like a clear mirror, the knower of rejectable and acceptable principles meditates on his own consciousness.

[tal-a13-v183] The net of accomplishments is spoken as cause of others' conviction; here accomplished ones are liberated at body's end through cultivation.

[tal-a13-v184] From strength of other cultivation one is called liberated while living; this mark is fully illustrated in the distinction of intuition.

[tal-a13-v185] In acts of curse and grace, by such practice and power, indifference to them liberates and liberates others.

[tal-a13-v186] The bound atom transmigrates through union of elements and senses; endowed with intuition, he is called the power principle.

[tal-a13-v187] Liberated from the ocean of becoming by descent-entry, Shiva indeed; from the teacher with senses that knowledge is called beyond senses.

[tal-a13-v188] Born of discrimination and by that intellect, how would it be sense-free? Thus questioned, it was answered from inertia.

[tal-a13-v189] Imperishability by thorough discrimination; Shiva illuminates that mind; the supremacy of all states is proclaimed.

[tal-a13-v190] Mind and intellect are not different; in discrimination as cause they are strengthened by the lord's power.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-krīḍāsu suviraktātmā śivabhāvaikabhāvitaḥ / māhātmyametatsuśroṇi prātibhasya vidhīyate svacchāyādarśavatpaśyedbahirantargataṃ śivam / heyopādeyatattvajñastadā dhyāyennijāṃ citim siddhijālaṃ hi kathitaṃ parapratyayakāraṇam / ihaiva siddhāḥ kāyānte mucyeranniti bhāvanāt parabhāvanadārḍhyāttu jīvanmukto nigadyate / etatte prātibhe bhede lakṣaṇaṃ samudāhṛtam śāpānugrahakāryeṣu tathābhyāsena śaktayā / teṣūdāsīnatāyāṃ tu mucyate mocayetparān bhūtendriyādiyogena baddho@ṇuḥ saṃsareddhruvam / sa eva pratibhāyuktaḥ śaktitattvaṃ nigadyate tatpātāveśato muktaḥ śiva eva bhavārṇavāt / nanvācāryātsendriyaṃ tajjñānamuktamatīndriyam vivekajaṃ ca tadbuddhyā tatkathaṃ syānnirindriyam / iti pṛṣṭo@bhyadhātsvāntadhiyorjāḍyaikavāsanāt akṣatvaṃ pravivekena tacchittau bhāsakaḥ śivaḥ / saṃskāraḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ paratā parikīrtitā manobuddhī na bhinne tu kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare / viveke kāraṇe hyete prabhuśaktyupavṛṃhite

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v191] Knowledge is not attained without mind and intellect, dear one; from the supreme state that subtle power principle is called.

[tal-a13-v192] Discrimination of all states arises from pure state in the great soul; the intellect principle has three gunas: high, low, and middle.

[tal-a13-v193] Gone to anima and the rest, binding too, inert-sensed — surely from intuition, in liberation, by initiation: what, in Shiva-rite?

[tal-a13-v194] Said knowledge indeed: in initiation, children fools women — from bond-cutting freed, awakened in Shiva-rite.

[tal-a13-v195] Therefore initiation becomes among these as cause, O beautiful one — but by initiation, in bond-liberation, from pure state, discrimination-born.

[tal-a13-v196] Thus this read text — who by themselves unable to understand, their, from concord with Shiva-words, understanding may go to firmness.

[tal-a13-v197] In glorious night-attack, and by self-guru-scripture-power threefold — knowledge principal: self-perception, ferrying across the conceptual ocean.

[tal-a13-v198] Doubt with mantra-self-become-substance hope, divine-tattva-etc. scope, rooted in concepts — ceases by own conviction.

[tal-a13-v199] Having grasped this inner-situated meaning — in Malini view, thus of this self, at some time from fitness.

[tal-a13-v200] The Shaiva power is bound, peaceful, liberation-fruit-giving — by that bond, then someone that moment is released.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-na manobuddhihīnastu jñānasyādhigamaḥ priye / parabhāvāttu tatsūkṣmaṃ śaktitattvaṃ nigadyate vivekaḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ śuddhabhāvānmahāśayaḥ / buddhitattvaṃ tu triguṇamuttamādhamamadhyamam aṇimādigataṃ cāpi bandhakaṃ jaḍamindriyam / nanu prātibhato muktau dīkṣayā kiṃ śivādhvare ūce@jñānā hi dīkṣāyāṃ bālavāliśayoṣitaḥ / pāśacchedādvimucyante prabuddhyante śivādhvare tasmāddīkṣā bhavatyeṣu kāraṇatvena sundari / dīkṣayā pāśamokṣe tu śuddhabhāvādvivekajam ityeṣa paṭhito granthaḥ svayaṃ ye boddhumakṣamāḥ / teṣāṃ śivoktisaṃvādādbodho dārḍhyaṃ vrajediti śrīmanniśāṭane cātmaguruśāstravaśāttridhā / jñānaṃ mukhyaṃ svopalabdhi vikalpārṇavatāraṇam mantrātmabhūtadravyāśadivyatattvādigocarā / śaṃkā vikalpamūlā hi śāmyetsvapratyayāditi enamevārthamantaḥsthaṃ gṛhītvā mālinīmate / evamasyātmanaḥ kāle kasmiṃścidyogyatāvaśāt śaivī saṃbadhyate śaktiḥ śāntā muktiphalapradā / tatsaṃbandhāttataḥ kaścittatkṣaṇādapavṛjyate

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v201] Having said thus, he speaks again of the intense-intense topic — oneness with ignorance ceases for someone.

[tal-a13-v202] Entered by Rudra-power, he desiring to go, by Shiva-will — for enjoyment-liberation accomplishment, is led to the true guru.

[tal-a13-v203] Having propitiated him, from the pleased one gaining Shankari initiation — that moment, by enjoyment, or at body-fall, to Shiva may go.

[tal-a13-v204] Of this meaning, the self's art, recollection-natured, toward own form — which, that very, someone, time, here declared.

[tal-a13-v205] Fitness is Shiva-identity-yoga-worthiness, so said — before, why not thus? Why then thus is unfitting.

[tal-a13-v206] Abandoning such appearance, there is indeed no time at all — but from freedom, in such appearance, let time-power blossom.

[tal-a13-v207] But not for questioning is she, in Shiva by his greatness glorified — indeed the Shaiva great power, bound with selves, stands; true, covering-natured, but peaceful — this one self-nature-seeing.

[tal-a13-v208] Agitation indeed is division; oneness only — calmed, identified with that, then.

[tal-a13-v209] By that peace bound, situated, power-nature-sharing — abandoned-atom-state he becomes, Shiva, from that power-firmness.

[tal-a13-v210] There too, from gradation and the rest, quick slow and the rest — his body-fall would be; or log-etc. sameness.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-ityuktvā tīvratīvrākhyaviṣayaṃ bhāṣate punaḥ / ajñānena sahaikatvaṃ kasyacidvinivartate rudraśaktisamāviṣṭaḥ sa yiyāsuḥ śivecchayā / bhuktimuktiprasiddhyarthaṃ nīyate sadguruṃ prati tamārādhya tatastuṣṭāddīkṣāmāsādya śāṅkarīm / tatkṣaṇādvopabhogādvā dehapātācchivaṃ vrajet asyārthā ātmanaḥ kācitkalanāmarśanātmikā / svaṃ rūpaṃ prati yā saiva ko@pi kāla ihoditaḥ yogyatā śivatādātmyayogārhatvamihocyate / pūrvaṃ kiṃ na tathā kasmāttadaiveti na saṃgatam tathābhāsanamujjhitvā na hi kālo@sti kaścana / svātantryāttu tathābhāse kālaśaktirvijṛmbhatām natu paryanuyuktyai sā śive tanmahimoditā / nanu śaivī mahāśaktiḥ saṃbaddhaivātmabhiḥ sthitā / satyaṃ sācchādanātmā tu śāntā tveṣā svarūpadṛk kṣobho hi bheda evaikyaṃ praśamastanmayī tataḥ tayā śāntyā tu saṃbaddhaḥ sthitaḥ śaktisvarūpabhāk / tyaktāṇubhāvo bhavati śivastacchaktidārḍhyataḥ tatrāpi tāratamyādivaśācchīghracirāditaḥ / dehapāto bhavedasya yadvā kāṣṭhāditulyatā

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v211] In all dealings, outward-turned conscious — entered by intense-intense great power, he succeeds.

[tal-a13-v212] Thus the prior-topic text, this much — elsewhere clearly another text, indicating middle-intense descent portion.

[tal-a13-v213] Ignorance-nature in man; awakening in contracted heart — in contraction ceased, own nature shines.

[tal-a13-v214] Rudra-power-entered — thereby his mark-group described; which said here: in Rudra devotion very firm.

[tal-a13-v215] Mantra-accomplishment, all-tattva mastery, action-prosperities, poetry, all-scripture-meaning-knower-ness, thus in that order.

[tal-a13-v216] By own-gradation-yoga may be theirs separate-collected-ness — there too, in enjoyment and liberation, primacy; let the wise discuss.

[tal-a13-v217] That ends: this text, second topic, clear — but other: toward mild-intense-named grace-descent rule.

[tal-a13-v218] From mild-intense power-force desire arises — by Shiva-will-force yoga, toward the true guru, he too.

[tal-a13-v219] Right here marked in scripture what was said by the Supreme Lord — who again all tattvas knows these truly.

[tal-a13-v220] He is declared guru my equal, mantra-potency revealer — seen, honored by him, touched, with pleased mind.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-samastavyavahāreṣu parācīnitacetanaḥ / tīvratīvramahāśaktisamāviṣṭaḥ sa sidhyati evaṃ prāgviṣayo grantha iyānanyatra tu sphuṭam / granthāntaraṃ madhyatīvraśaktipātāṃśasūcakam ajñānarūpatā puṃsi bodhaḥ saṃkocite hṛdi / saṃkoce vinivṛtte tu svasvabhāvaḥ prakāśate rudraśaktisamāviṣṭa ityanenāsya varṇyate / cihnavargo ya ukto@tra rudre bhaktiḥ suniścalā mantrasiddhiḥ sarvatattvavaśitvaṃ kṛtyasaṃpadaḥ / kavitvaṃ sarvaśāstrārthaboddhṛtvamiti tatkramāt svatāratamyayogātsyādeṣāṃ vyastasamastatā / tatrāpi bhuktau muktau ca prādhānyaṃ carcayedbudhaḥ sa ityanto grantha eṣa dvitīyaviṣayaḥ sphuṭaḥ / anyastu mandatīvrākhyaśaktipātavidhiṃ prati mandatīvrācchaktibalādyiyāsāsyopajāyate / śivecchāvaśayogena sadguruṃ prati so@pi ca atraiva lakṣitaḥ śāstre yaduktaṃ parameṣṭhinā / yaḥ punaḥ sarvatattvāni vettyetāni yathārthataḥ sa gururmatsamaḥ prokto mantravīryaprakāśakaḥ / dṛṣṭāḥ saṃbhāvitāstena spṛṣṭāśca prītacetasā

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v221] Men are freed from evils, even seven-birth-made — who re-initiated by him, beings Shiva-impelled.

[tal-a13-v222] They attaining desired fruit go to the disease-free state — what reality, who reality-knower, by consideration-yoga?

[tal-a13-v223] From intuition, friend-company, toward guru one would desire to go — thus from going-desire yoga the teacher is attained, and he.

[tal-a13-v224] By gradation-etc. yoga accomplished, consecrated too — prior-difference sharing, suddenly, gradually, wholly, partially.

[tal-a13-v225] Thus-beginning difference-divided indeed, guru-gain here declared — therefore initiation he obtains immediately indeed, Shiva-giving.

[tal-a13-v226] As knowledge-formed he knows all indeed truly — living-liberated, Shiva-become then, this is called.

[tal-a13-v227] Body-connection even his, for Shiva-ness, because clear — in this, difference indeed, by telling, association, seeing.

[tal-a13-v228] From scripture-transmission, equality-conduct-showing of the wanderer — from mantra-mudra-etc. greatness, whole-part difference.

[tal-a13-v229] By action or by inner-form breath-entry — then, even body-situated, he is liberated, so said.

[tal-a13-v230] And said in the two scriptures, glorious Ratnamala and Agama-called — at which time by the guru the non-conceptual is revealed.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-narāḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyante saptajanmakṛtairapi / ye punardīkṣitāstena prāṇinaḥ śivacoditāḥ te yatheṣṭaṃ phalaṃ prāpya padaṃ gacchantyanāmayam / kiṃ tattvaṃ tattvavedī ka ityāmarśanayogataḥ pratibhānātsuḥṛtsaṅgādgurau jigamiṣurbhavet / evaṃ jigamiṣāyogādācāryaḥ prāpyate sa ca tāratamyādiyogena saṃsiddhaḥ saṃskṛto@pi ca / prāgbhedabhāgī jhaṭiti kramātsāmastyatoṃśataḥ ityādibhedabhinno hi gurorlābha ihoditaḥ / tasmāddīkṣāṃ sa labhate sadya eva śivapradām jñānarūpāṃ yathā vetti sarvameva yathārthataḥ / jīvanmuktaḥ śivībhūtastadaivāsau nigadyate dehasaṃbandhitāpyasya śivatāyai yataḥ sphuṭā / asyāṃ bhedo hi kathanātsaṅgamādavalokanāt śāstrātsaṃkramaṇātsāmyacaryāsaṃdarśanāccaroḥ / mantramudrādimāhātmyātsamastavyastabhedataḥ kriyayā vāntarākārarūpaprāṇapraveśataḥ / tadā ca dehasaṃstho@pi sa mukta iti bhaṇyate uktaṃ ca śāstrayoḥ śrīmadratnamālāgamākhyayoḥ / yasminkāle tu guruṇā nirvikalpaṃ prakāśitam

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v231] Right then indeed liberated, he stands a mere machine — from begun-karma connection of the body, in pleasure-pain.

[tal-a13-v232] Do not doubt; and that, in Sri-gama scripture determined — nescience-served body, from other-birth arising.

[tal-a13-v233] By that action obstructed, even knowers, in body — caste-lifespan-enjoyment single-patch-ness standing.

[tal-a13-v234] From said one-word indeed — that by it thus coherence; from practice-reasoning-permeated piercing-grinding blocking.

[tal-a13-v235] Or of offering, from mantra-power bond-cutting practice — immediate-liberation-giving, make immediately breath-severing.

[tal-a13-v236] There, but this is the rule: at near death-moment, do that — not otherwise, begun karma, since not purified.

[tal-a13-v237] Said before indeed: from mantra-power yoga — breath-severed even this enjoys remaining fruit, because.

[tal-a13-v238] That-birth remainder, various-transcending, then clearly — by other-karma blocking, quickly indeed is released.

[tal-a13-v239] Therefore breath-taking initiation, not without knowing death-moment, would do — supreme-command transgression only fruit indeed it.

[tal-a13-v240] One triad this, determined — in grace-descent even otherwise; but in intense-middle, in initiation done, not thus firm.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-tadaiva kila mukto@sau yantraṃ tiṣṭhati kevalam / prārabdhṛkarmasaṃbandhāddehasya sukhiduḥkhite na viśaṅketa tacca śrīgamaśāstre nirūpitam / avidyopāsito deho hyanyajanmasamudbhuvā karmaṇā tena bādhyante jñānino@pi kalevare / jātyāyurbhogadasyaikapraghaṭṭakatayā sthitiḥ uktaikavacanāddhiśca yatastenetisaṃgatiḥ / abhyāsayuktisaṃkrāntivedhaghaṭṭanarodhataḥ hutervā mantrasāmarthyātpāśacchedaprayogataḥ / sadyonirvāṇadāṃ kuryātsadyaḥprāṇaviyojikām tatra tveṣo@sti niyama āsanne maraṇakṣaṇe / tāṃ kuryānnānyathārabdhṛ karma yasmānna śuddhyati uktaṃ ca pūrvamevaitanmaṃtrasāmarthyayogataḥ / prāṇairviyojito@pyeṣa bhuṅkte śeṣaphalaṃ yataḥ tajjanmaśeṣaṃ vividhamativāhya tataḥ sphuṭam / karmāntaranirodhena śīghramevāpavṛjyate tasmātprāṇaharīṃ dīkṣāṃ nājñātvā maraṇakṣaṇam / vidadhyātparameśājñālaṅghanaikaphalā hi sā ekastriko@yaṃ nirṇītaḥ śaktipāte@pyathāparaḥ / tīvramadhye tu dīkṣāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ na tathā dṛḍhām

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v241] Of own self knows Shiva-ness; at body-end becomes Shiva — as said in night-course and yoga-course scriptures.

[tal-a13-v242] But from imagination, stood in body, at burning-end may go to Shiva-ness — in middle-middle descent, even Shiva-gain-eager being.

[tal-a13-v243] Desirous of enjoyment, where joined, having enjoyed that, at body-decay Shiva — but in mild-middle, there indeed in principle, somewhere appointed.

[tal-a13-v244] At body-end, gone-to-principle enjoyment having enjoyed, afterwards to Shiva may go — there too from gradation-possibility, slow-quick-ness.

[tal-a13-v245] Much-little enjoyment-yoga and body-abundance-smallness course — in intense-mild, middle-mild, mild-mild, desire to enjoy.

[tal-a13-v246] In order chiefly, by rule to the end, Shiva — others' desire-to-go texts, prior-text-consistent.

[tal-a13-v247] They make middle-intense-named power-descent object — when intuition-entered even this, concord-joining.

[tal-a13-v248] Desiring desiring-to-go becomes, then would be led to true guru — not all intuition-entered by power would be led to true guru.

[tal-a13-v249] Thus speaks: going-desire-ness must be stated, not otherwise, certain — rudra-power-entered is led toward true guru.

[tal-a13-v250] Thereby attained-discrimination-born knowledge-complete mind — firmness-concord-growth-from, desiring-to-go becomes, clearly.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-svātmano vetti śivatāṃ dehānte tu śivo bhavet / uktaṃ ca niśisaṃcārayogasaṃcāraśāstrayoḥ vikalpāttu tanau sthitvā dahānte śivatāṃ vrajet / madhyamadhye śaktipāte śivalābhotsuko@pi san bubhukṣuryatra yuktastadbhuktvā dehakṣaye śivaḥ / mandamadhye tu tatraiva tattve kvāpi niyojitaḥ dehānte tattvagaṃ bhogaṃ bhuktvā paścācchivaṃ vrajet / tatrāpi tāratamyasya saṃbhavācciraśīghratā bahvalpabhogayogaśca dehabhūmālpatākramaḥ / tīvramande madhyamande mandamande bubhukṣutā kramānmukhyātimātreṇa vidhinaityantataḥ śivam / anye yiyāsurityādigranthaṃ prāggranthasaṃgatam kurvanti madhyatīvrākhyaśaktisaṃpātagocaram / yadā pratibhayāviṣṭo@pyeṣa saṃvādayojanām icchanyiyāsurbhavati tadā nīyeta sadgurum / na sarvaḥ pratibhāviṣṭaḥ śaktyā nīyeta sadgurum iti brūte yiyāsutvaṃ vaktavyaṃ nānyathā dhruvam / rudraśaktisamāviṣṭo nīyate sadguruṃ prati tena prāptavivekotthajñānasaṃpūrṇamānasaḥ / dārḍhyasaṃvādarūḍhyāderyiyāsurbhavati sphuṭam

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v251] Said in Nandisikha-tantra, in eastern six, by Maheshin — desire in Shiva, in God, of beasts arises then.

[tal-a13-v252] When by Shaiva conceit joined indeed, ultimate atoms — right then they, liberated but initiated by guru, because.

[tal-a13-v253] From mere attainment they are understood accomplished-and-to-be-accomplished — having propitiated him thus, but the text has mild-intense only as object.

[tal-a13-v254] Ninefold this grace-descent, by Shambhunatha described — this essence here to be known, of the full consciousness-self.

[tal-a13-v255] Light supreme, grace-descent undivided — such-like even, by enjoyment-portion limit marked.

[tal-a13-v256] The other descent gives Shiva-ness at the end — in both even, of karma and the rest within Maya, because.

[tal-a13-v257] No activity, thus indeed; independent he, all round — thereby in Maya-interval who are Rudras, and who above that.

[tal-a13-v258] In own-office destruction, by those become Bhairavi, forcibly — who by Maya indeed unseized, karma-and-the-like independent.

[tal-a13-v259] From descent-force indeed, that accomplishment resorted to — indeed by worship-japa-meditation-Shiva-service and the rest.

[tal-a13-v260] They mantra-etc.-ness attained — how karma-independent? Not so: in such transcended Shiva-meditation-japa and the rest.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-uktaṃ nandiśikhātantre prācyaṣaṭke maheśinā / abhilāṣaḥ śive deve paśūnāṃ bhavate tadā yadā śaivābhimānena yuktā vai paramāṇavaḥ / tadaiva te vimuktāstu dīkṣitā guruṇā yataḥ prāptimātrācca te siddhasādhyā iti hi gamyate / tamārādhyeti tu grantho mandatīvraikagocaraḥ navadhā śaktipāto@yaṃ śaṃbhunāthena varṇitaḥ / idaṃ sāramiha jñeyaṃ paripūrṇacidātmanaḥ prakāśaḥ paramaḥ śaktipāto@vacchedavarjitaḥ / tathāvidho@pi bhogāṃśāvacchedenopalakṣitaḥ aparaḥ śaktipāto@sau paryante śivatāpradaḥ / ubhayatrāpi karmādermāyāntarvartino yataḥ nāsti vyāpāra ityevaṃ nirapekṣaḥ sa sarvataḥ / tena māyāntarāle ye rudrā ye ca tadūrdhvataḥ svādhikārakṣaye taistairbhairavībhūyate haṭhāt / ye māyayā hyanākrāntāste karmādyanapekṣiṇaḥ śaktipātavaśādeva tāṃ tāṃ siddhimupāśritāḥ / nanu pūjājapadhyānaśaṃkarāsevanādibhiḥ te mantrāditvamāpannāḥ kathaṃ karmānapekṣiṇaḥ / maivaṃ tathāvidhottīrṇaśivadhyānajapādiṣu

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v261] Proceeding indeed first of these — why be distinguished? Karma-its-sameness-dispassion-impurity-ripening etc. refuted.

[tal-a13-v262] Lord-will is cause; and if descent-sole-causality — japa-and-the-like is action-power indeed thus, but not karma, that.

[tal-a13-v263] Action, that world-customary indeed, giving inferior enjoyment, conceals enjoyer-form — of designation, but not our burden.

[tal-a13-v264] Their enjoyment-excess, whence thus — if answer given: variegated-form light this, independent supreme Lord.

[tal-a13-v265] But from freedom, concealment-bond — in his enjoyment nourishing own enjoyer-form indeed — would be mala-karma-and-the-rest-free.

[tal-a13-v266] Said: this Shiva's action-power, beast-dwelling, is binder — that action is called form-concealing maker.

[tal-a13-v267] Known, and action-power, immediately accomplishment-furnishing — unbroken self-awareness expanse; accomplishment here is said.

[tal-a13-v268] She, enjoyment-liberation-freedom great-fortune, here imperishable — Vishnu-and-rest formedness in god, which, some, she by own self.

[tal-a13-v269] By difference-yoga force, Maya-state mid-situated — thereby, by that-form-ness yoga, descent situated even, being.

[tal-a13-v270] So much enjoyment lays; at end Shiva-hood, but not — as from freedom even a king favors someone.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-pravṛttireva prathamameṣāṃ kasmādvivicyatām / karmatatsāmyavairāgyamalapākādi dūṣitam īśvarecchā nimittaṃ cecchaktipātaikahetutā / japādikā kriyāśaktirevetthaṃ natu karma tat karma tallokarūḍhaṃ hi yadbhogamavaraṃ dadat / tirodhatte bhoktṛrūpaṃ saṃjñāyā tu na no bharaḥ teṣāṃ bhogotkatā kasmāditi ceddattamuttaram / citrākāraprakāśo@yaṃ svatantraḥ parameśvaraḥ svātantryāttu tirobhāvabandho bhoge@sya bhoktṛtām / puṣṇansvaṃ rūpameva syānmalakarmādivarjitam uktaṃ seyaṃ kriyāśaktiḥ śivasya paśuvartinī / bandhayitrīti tatkarma kathyate rūpalopakṛt jñātā sā ca kriyāśaktiḥ sadyaḥ siddhyupapādikā / avicchinnasvātmasaṃvitprathā siddhirihocyate sā bhogamokṣasvātantryamahālakṣmīrihākṣayā / viṣṇvādirūpatā deve yā kācitsā nijātmanā bhedayogavaśānmāyāpadamadhyavyavasthitā / tena tadrūpatāyogācchaktipātaḥ sthito@pi san tāvantaṃ bhogamādhatte paryante śivatāṃ natu / yathā svātantryato rājāpyanugṛhṇāti kaṃcana

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v271] Thus from lord-power entry, Vishnu and the rest indeed — from Maya-garbha-authority descent-force, then.

[tal-a13-v272] Someone pradhana-purusha-discriminating, gone from nature — from excellent that, quickly indeed, someone awakened to discriminativeness.

[tal-a13-v273] From moment, of person, of kala — man-Maya-interval knower; of kala-abode even completely, from action turning away.

[tal-a13-v274] Jnanakala, former but active, from its abode-standing — he, the supreme, at nature-root creation does not approach, ever thus.

[tal-a13-v275] But on Maya-holders, may be created by Ananta-lord, from impulsion — vijnanakala-ness attained, from mere authority.

[tal-a13-v276] From impurity, mantra-its-lords-etc. states attains always — from Shiva, from lord, from supreme — this descent indeed, from impurity.

[tal-a13-v277] From named ignorance thus separated — Shiva-state revealing; not by another: Shiva-state indeed by anyone is fully revealed.

[tal-a13-v278] In Svacchanda scripture, by that said: of disputants — three hundred sixty-three exceeding, deluded, Vaishnava and the rest, at night-end.

[tal-a13-v279] Shiva-knowledge alone, Shiva-ness-attainment-giving — grace-descent ending in Shiva-ness attainment is discussed.

[tal-a13-v280] Otherwise what would that be, unpresided by Shaiva power — thereby here of Vaishnava and the rest, no eligibility ever.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-īśaśaktisamāveśāttathā viṣṇvādayo@pyalam / māyāgarbhādhikārīyaśaktipātavaśāttataḥ ko@pi pradhānapuruṣavivekī prakṛtergataḥ / utkṛṣṭāttata evāśu ko@pi buddhā vivekitām kṣaṇātpuṃsaḥ kalāyāśca puṃmāyāntaravedakaḥ / kalāśrayasyāpyatyantaṃ karmaṇo vinivartanāt jñānākalaḥ prāktanastu karmī tasyāśrayasthiteḥ / sa paraṃ prakṛterbudhne sṛṣṭiṃ nāyāti jātucit māyādhare tu sṛjyetānanteśena pracodanāt / vijñānākalatāṃ prāptaḥ kevalādadhikārataḥ malānmantratadīśādibhāvameti sadā śivāt / patyuḥ parasmādyastveṣa śaktipātaḥ sa vai malāt ajñānākhyādviyokteti śivabhāvaprakāśakaḥ / nānyena śivabhāvo hi kenacitsaṃprakāśate svacchandaśāstre tenoktaṃ vādināṃ tu śatatrayam / triṣaṣṭyabhyadhikaṃ bhrāntaṃ vaiṣṇavādyaṃ niśāntare śivajñānaṃ kevalaṃ ca śivatāpattidāyakam / śivatāpattiparyantaḥ śaktipātaśca carcyate anyathā kiṃ hi tatsyādyacchaivyā śaktyānadhiṣṭhitam / teneha vaiṣṇavādīnāṃ nādhikāraḥ kathaṃcana

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v281] They indeed from difference-only coursing, in nonduality far excluded — but from the great Lord's freedom, they too, if Shiva-facing.

[tal-a13-v282] Twofold consecration is theirs — by linga-extraction then by initiation; on bad-residue departure, with flowers the vessel is consecrated.

[tal-a13-v283] Twofold his consecration — not thus in the pure vessel is the rule; thus this glorious grace-descent, independent, here declared.

[tal-a13-v284] By this very direction to be led: Matanga-raya and the rest — from text-weight fear, but having written that, not applied.

[tal-a13-v285] In Purana too, of that very, from grace devotion is accepted — by which they go to supreme accomplishment, mind-gone to his state.

[tal-a13-v286] By 'only,' action-etc. dependence is denied — grace is purification thereby, full-form-ness.

[tal-a13-v287] By self, by that, indeed Shiva himself full shines — in Shivahood-great-accomplishment-touch-barren, but somewhere.

[tal-a13-v288] In Vaishnava and the rest, which devotion — not that from Shiva alone; Shiva becomes; there this is cause, but not alone.

[tal-a13-v289] Pure grace, removing dependence on limited action, leads to supreme perfection and life.

[tal-a13-v290] Even our supreme teacher Utpaladeva says the lord never deliberates when grace descends.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-te hi bhedaikavṛttitvādabhede dūravarjitāḥ / svātantryāttu maheśasya te@pi cecchivatonmukhāḥ dviguṇā saṃskriyāstyeṣāṃ liṅgoddhṛtyātha dīkṣayā / duṣṭādhivāsavigame puṣpaiḥ kumbho@dhivāsyate dviguṇo@sya sa saṃskāro netthaṃ śuddhe ghaṭe vidhiḥ / itthaṃ śrīśaktipāto@yaṃ nirapekṣa ihoditaḥ anayaiva diśā neyaṃ mataṅgakiraṇādikam / granthagauravabhītyā tu tallikhitvā na yojitam purāṇe@pi ca tasyaiva prasādādbhaktiriṣyate / yayā yānti parāṃ siddhiṃ tadbhāvagatamānasāḥ evakāreṇa karmādisāpekṣatvaṃ niṣidhyate / prasādo nirmalībhāvastena saṃpūrṇarūpatā ātmanā tena hi śivaḥ svayaṃ pūrṇaḥ prakāśate / śivībhāvamahāsiddhisparśavandhye tu kutracit vaiṣṇavādau hi yā bhaktirnāsau kevalataḥ śivāt / śivo bhavati tatraiṣa kāraṇaṃ na tu kevalaḥ nirmalaścāpi tu prāptāvacchitkarmādyapekṣakaḥ / yayā yānti parāṃ siddhimityasyedaṃ tu jīvitam śrīmānutpaladevaścāpyasmākaṃ paramo guruḥ / śaktipātasamaye vicāraṇaṃ prāptamīśa na karoṣi karhicit

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v291] Today what has come toward me? Because you delay in self-manifestation, though non-dependence on words has been declared.

[tal-a13-v292] Rarity and non-attachment in the lord's grace descent reveal the variegation of that very grace by half-measures.

[tal-a13-v293] The glorious unobstructed one describes the lord's awakening power through delays, long and short differences, and so on.

[tal-a13-v294] In the Matanga, independence is described as the god's own-form unfolding, even at the end of immovable beings.

[tal-a13-v295] Descending power is never dependent anywhere; thus, even when this varied grace descent is established, it remains so.

[tal-a13-v296] By gradation differences and so on, variegation among initiates arises; some attain a rudra-hundred measure through that grace.

[tal-a13-v297] An initiate may gradually attain shivahood; some pure-path-bound son attains it quickly and without sequence.

[tal-a13-v298] By an enjoyment obstacle, some practitioner is slow or quick; some is fully obligated in a share of the five acts.

[tal-a13-v299] The teacher standing in form also bears enjoyment, liberation, and other differences for the fourfold initiate, by summary and expansion.

[tal-a13-v300] By gradual, immediate, and other differences, grace descent is variegated; gradual grace descent is in Siddhanta and Vama, then.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-adya māṃ prati kimāgataṃ yataḥ svaprakāśanavidhau vilambase / karhicitprāptaśabdābhyāmanapekṣitvamūcivān durlabhatvamarāgitvaṃ śaktipātavidhau vibhoḥ / aparārdhena tasyaiva śaktipātasya citratām vyavadhānacirakṣiprabhedādyairupavarṇitaiḥ / śrīmatāpyaniruddhena śaktimunmīlinīṃ vibhoḥ vyācakṣāṇena mātaṅge varṇitā nirapekṣatā / sthāvarānte@pi devasya svarūponmīlanātmikā śaktiḥ patantī sāpekṣā na kvāpīti suvistarāt / evaṃ vicitre@pyetasmiñchaktipāte sthite sati tāratamyādibhirbhedaiḥ samayyādivicitratā / kaścidrudrāśatāmātrāpādanāttatprasādataḥ śivatvaṃ kramaśo gacchet samayī yo nirūpyate / kaścicchuddhādhvabandhaḥ san putrakaḥ śīghramakramāt bhogavyavadhinā ko@pi sādhakaściraśīghrataḥ / kaścitsaṃpūrṇakartavyaḥ kṛtyapañcakabhāgini rūpe sthito guruḥ so@pi bhogamokṣādibhedabhāk / samayyādicatuṣkasya samāsavyāsayogataḥ kramākramādibhirbhedaiḥ śaktipātasya citratā / kramikaḥ śaktipātaśca siddhānte vāmake tataḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v301] In Daksha, Mata, Kula, Kaula, half-of-six, and heart, then, or by transcending power, suddenly and without sequence, or.

[tal-a13-v302] It is said in the glorious Bhairava Kula: the teacher, well-prepared by five initiations and transcending the lower stream, indeed follows Trika scripture.

[tal-a13-v303] By knowledge, conduct, and other differences, indeed superiority and inferiority arise; the lord is in such glorious scriptures of all conduct, heart, and so on.

[tal-a13-v304] Even a teacher anointed in the left path and knowing the supreme principle still deserves purification again in the Bhairava tantra.

[tal-a13-v305] Shaiva, Vaimala, Siddhanta, Arhats, and artisans—all are to be known as bound souls in Bhairava's mother circle.

[tal-a13-v306] In Kula Kali procedure it is indeed said: especially Vaishnavas, and those devoted to ash and so on, have no fitness.

[tal-a13-v307] In the Svacchanda scripture, glorious Mahesha said briefly: one devoted to other scripture is not a giver of accomplishment fruit.

[tal-a13-v308] Indeed a teacher is considered one who obtained anointment by initiate sequence; and what connection is there, thus by power, among Vaishnavas and others?

[tal-a13-v309] By deceit, false hearing, and so on, one taking that knowledge may incur penance; thus what qualification may be here?

[tal-a13-v310] A disciple endowed with desire for fruit, whose accomplishment depends on that, would certainly be cooked in hell by resorting to penance.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-dakṣe mate kule kaule ṣaḍardhe hṛdaye tataḥ / ullaṅghanavaśādvāpi jhaṭityakramameva vā uktaṃ śrībhairavakule pañcadīkṣāsusaṃskṛtaḥ / gururullaṅghitādhaḥsthasrotā vai trikaśāstragaḥ jñānācārādibhedena hyuttarādharatā vibhuḥ / śāstreṣvadīdṛśacchrīmatsarvācārahṛdādiṣu vāmamārgābhiṣiktastu daiśikaḥ paratattvavit / tathāpi bhairave tantre punaḥ saṃskāramarhati śaivavaimalasiddhāntā ārhatāḥ kārukāśca ye / sarve te paśavo jñeyā bhairave mātṛmaṇḍale kulakālīvidhau coktaṃ vaiṣṇavānā viśeṣataḥ / bhasmaniṣṭhāprapannānāmityādau naiva yogyatā svacchandaśāstre saṃkṣepāduktaṃ ca śrīmaheśinā / anyaśāstrarato yastu nāsau siddhiphalapradaḥ samayyādikramāllabdhābhiṣeko hi gururmataḥ / sa ca śaktivaśāditthaṃ vaiṣṇavādiṣu ko@nvayaḥ chadmāpaśravaṇādyaistu tajjñānaṃ gṛhṇato bhavet / prāyaścittamatastādṛgadhikāryatra kiṃ bhavet phalākāṅkṣāyutaḥ śiṣyastadekāyattasiddhikaḥ / dhruvaṃ pacyeta narake prāyaścittyupasevanāt

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v311] This concealment mode, appointed in such a teacher by Shiva, with devotion to him, is not called his grace descent.

[tal-a13-v312] When by variety force one knows his such reversed conduct state, knowledge, therefore one should remove it.

[tal-a13-v313] One should abandon sinful conduct and become devoted to knowledge, just as a king seizes wealth taken from a thief.

[tal-a13-v314] Likewise, from Vaishnava and other sources, the right-minded one takes Shaiva knowledge; even when heard, a single mode of difference remains in Shiva-knowledge.

[tal-a13-v315] It is said he does not abandon firmly; the best bound soul stationed in Vama is concealed and placed by Shiva alone, by force of order.

[tal-a13-v316] How should the dependent one proceed step by step? The scripture of free will says this, and it addresses those devoted among Vaishnavas and others.

[tal-a13-v317] Maya indeed deludes them in non-liberation, by desire for liberation; Vaishnava and others join Shaiva scripture to their own teaching.

[tal-a13-v318] Certainly, one who has fallen into doubt may go to loss of both, in his own view and in the other's view, from transgressing agreement.

[tal-a13-v319] Because harm approaches, one should practice such a course; it was said by the supreme lord in glorious Gahvara.

[tal-a13-v320] Shiva-knowledge does not shine among those engaged in other scriptures; the Siddhantin is not in the left, nor is he in the right, in our opinion.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-tirobhāvaprakāro@yaṃ yattādṛśi niyojitaḥ / gurau śivena tadbhaktiḥ śaktipāto@sya nocyate yadātu vaicitryavaśājjānīyāttasya tādṛśam / viparītapravṛttatvaṃ jñānaṃ tasmādupāharet taṃ ca tyajetpāpavṛttiṃ bhavettu jñānatatparaḥ / yathā caurādgṛhītvārthaṃ taṃ nigṛhṇāti bhūpatiḥ vaiṣṇavādestathā śaivaṃ jñānamāhṛtya sanmatiḥ / sa hi bhedaikavṛttitvaṃ śivajñāne śrute@pyalam nojjhatīti dṛḍhaṃ vāmādhiṣṭhitastatpaśūttamaḥ / śivenaiva tirobhāvya sthāpito niyaterbalāt kathaṅkāraṃ patipadaṃ prayātu paratantritaḥ / svacchandaśāstre proktaṃ ca vaiṣṇavādiṣu ye ratāḥ bhramayatyeva tānmāyā hyamokṣe mokṣalipsayā / vaiṣṇavādiḥ śaivaśāstraṃ melayannijaśāsane dhruvaṃ saṃśayamāpanna ubhayabhraṣṭatāṃ vrajet / svadṛṣṭau paradṛṣṭau ca samayollaṅghanādasau pratyavāyaṃ yato@bhyeti carettannedṛśaṃ kramam / uktaṃ śrīmadgahvare ca parameśena tādṛśam nānyaśāstrābhiyuktaṣu śivajñānaṃ prakāśate / tanna saiddhāntiko vāme nāsau dakṣe sa no mate

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v321] He is not the former in Kula, Kaula, or Trika; elsewhere he is bounded or unbounded, and does not know infinity situated.

[tal-a13-v322] The all-enduring one is below, the authorized one is above; the teacher enlivens lower actions by touching the lower.

[tal-a13-v323] The supreme teacher makes fruitful that which is above; even one below, seeing such, serving the teacher, may become he.

[tal-a13-v324] One kindled by such descent of power may quickly lead this upward, in a field-seat bounded like a mountain-river.

[tal-a13-v325] Even with ever-higher knowledge, one who is a lower bearer does not become qualified; one must seek a progressively higher teacher.

[tal-a13-v326] One who performs unqualified action and transgresses scripture becomes punishable; by grace-power alone there is varied fitness for knowledge.

[tal-a13-v327] Scriptural, thought-born, and meditation-born knowledge exist, but meditation-born knowledge beyond them is greater because it alone is the cause of liberation.

[tal-a13-v328] How could one extract from principles or make connection at any time without supreme meditation-born knowledge?

[tal-a13-v329] Even a yogi who has attained perfection in principles up to the highest place beginning with Sadashiva becomes a connector only through habituated knowledge.

[tal-a13-v330] Even firm perfection born of yoga in lower principles is not a means for liberation, like a wealth-tree.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-kulakaule trike nāsau pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ paratra tu / avacchinno@navacchedaṃ no vettyānantyasaṃsthitaḥ sarvaṃsahastato@dhaḥstha ūrdhvastho@dhikṛto guruḥ / svātmīyādharasaṃsparśātprāṇayannadharāḥ kriyāḥ saphalīkurute yattadūrdhvastho gururuttamaḥ / adhaḥsthadṛkstho@pyetādṛggurusevī bhavetsa yaḥ tādṛkśaktinipāteddho yo drāgūrdhvamimaṃ nayet / tattadgirinadīprāyāvacchinne kṣetrapīṭhake uttarottaravijñāne nādhikāryadharo@dharaḥ / uttarottaramācāryaṃ vidannapyadharo@dharaḥ kurvannadhikriyāṃ śāstralaṅghī nigrahabhājanam / śaktipātabalādeva jñānayogyavicitratā śrautaṃ cintāmayaṃ dvyātma bhāvanāmayameva ca / jñānaṃ taduttaraṃ jyāyo yato mokṣaikakāraṇam tattvebhya uddhṛtiṃ kvāpi yojanaṃ sakale@kale / kathaṃ kuryādvinā jñānaṃ bhāvanāmayamuttamam yogī tu prāptatattattvasiddhirapyuttame pade / sadāśivādye svabhyastajñānitvādeva yojakaḥ adhareṣu ca tattveṣu yā siddhiryogajāsya sā / vimocanāyāṃ nopāyaḥ sthitāpi dhanadāravat

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v331] He who has arisen with perfection of all paths is indeed Sadashiva; how would this directly present one liberate mortals while going?

[tal-a13-v332] As said in the Malini Tantra, considering one joined with knowledge, the wise declare the possessor of habituated knowledge to be liberating.

[tal-a13-v333] Therefore habituated knowledge alone is the one mark of a guru; this distinction, declared by me, is shown by Shambhunatha.

[tal-a13-v334] One intent on liberation-knowledge should make the habituated knower guru and abandon even an already obtained other; thus it was said by Shiva.

[tal-a13-v335] As a bee seeking fragrance goes from flower to flower, so a disciple seeking knowledge may go from guru to another guru.

[tal-a13-v336] Having obtained a powerless guru, how could one rely on him for liberation-knowledge, O goddess? From a tree with destroyed root, whence flowers and fruits?

[tal-a13-v337] Seeing higher-and-higher excellence-fortune, yet situated in the lowest — who in place? Therefore who else would be fate-burnt?

[tal-a13-v338] But who enjoyment and liberation and desires knowledge only — self-practiced knower, yoga-accomplished: he should resort to guru.

[tal-a13-v339] In that absence, resort to the knowledge-liberation knower — in enjoyment-share, the yogin who would be able to give that fruit.

[tal-a13-v340] In fruit-giving-incapable, danger-only-teaching yogin — better the knower who shows means and would liberate.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-yastūtpannasamastādhvasiddhiḥ sahi sadāśivaḥ / sākṣādeṣa kathaṃ martyānmocayedgurutāṃ vrajan tenoktaṃ mālinītantre vicārya jñānayogite / yataśca mokṣadaḥ proktaḥ svabhyastajñānavānbudhaiḥ tasmātsvabhyastavijñānataivaikaṃ gurulakṣaṇam / vibhāgastveṣa me proktaḥ śaṃbhunāthena darśyate mokṣajñānaparaḥ kuryādguruṃ svabhyastavedanam / anyaṃ tyajetprāptamapi tathācoktaṃ śivena tat āmodārthī yathā bhṛṅgaḥ puṣpātpuṣpāntaraṃ vrajet / vijñānārthī tathā śiṣyo gurorgurvantaraṃ vrajet śaktihīnaṃ guruṃ prāpya mokṣajñāne kathaṃ śrayet / naṣṭamūle drume devi kutaḥ puṣpaphalādikam uttarottaramutkarṣalakṣmīṃ paśyannapi sthitaḥ / adhame yaḥ pade tasmātko@nyaḥ syāddaivadagdhakaḥ yastu bhogaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca vāñchedvijñānameva ca / svabhyastajñāninaṃ yogasiddhaṃ sa gurumāśrayet tadabhāve tu vijñānamokṣayorjñāninaṃ śrayet / bhuktyaṃśe yoginaṃ yastatphalaṃ dātuṃ bhavetkṣamaḥ phaladānākṣame yoginyapāyaikopadeśini / varaṃ jñānī yo@bhyupāyaṃ diśedapica mocayet

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v341] Knower, not full, just one — if by part-of-part order, having taken knowledges, would make discernment, unbroken circle.

[tal-a13-v342] Thereby countless gurus make, for filling own awareness — but blessed: full discernment the knowledge-seeker obtains guru.

[tal-a13-v343] Various guru-tradition-stream intuition-only mixed, having made the knowledge-ocean — by own drops would flood, or what?

[tal-a13-v344] Up to Tapana-to-Motaka-end, whose is my guru-sequence — his, my, of all disciples, no teaching-poverty.

[tal-a13-v345] By glorious Kallata thus, by guru described — I too therefore, from lower-scripture-view curiosity.

[tal-a13-v346] Logicians vedists buddhists jains vishnu-followers I did not serve — from world-soul-beyond-path karma-yoga ordination.

[tal-a13-v347] From awakening-excess abundance, contemplate the gradually excellent — in former scripture, questioners: sages Narada and the rest.

[tal-a13-v348] Former Vishnu-followers and buddhists, knowing siddhanta and the rest thence — gradually trika-meaning knowledge-moon eager-sighted.

[tal-a13-v349] Therefore never doubt guru-multitude — in another-guru-delighting fool, in other-agama serving.

[tal-a13-v350] Falling-away which is declared, that thus let be understood — who, where, in treatise authorized, he there is called guru.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-jñānī na pūrṇa evaiko yadi hyaṃśāṃśikākramāt / jñānānyādāya vijñānaṃ kurvītākhaṇḍamaṇḍalam tenāsaṃkhyāngurūnkuryātpūraṇāya svasaṃvidaḥ / dhanyastu pūrṇavijñānaṃ jñānārthī labhate gurum nānāgurvāgamasrotaḥpratibhāmātramiśritam / kṛtvā jñānārṇavaṃ svābhirvipruṅgiḥ plāvayenna kim ā tapanānmoṭakāntaṃ yasya me@sti gurukramaḥ / tasya me sarvaśiṣyasya nopadeśadaridratā śrīmatā kallaṭenetthaṃ guruṇā tu nyarūpyata / ahamapyata evādhaḥśāstradṛṣṭikutūhalāt tārkikaśrautabauddhārhadvaiṣṇavādīnnaseviṣi / lokādhyātmātimārgādikarmayogavidhānataḥ saṃbodhotkarṣabāhulyātkramotkṛṣṭānvibhāvayet / śrīpūrvaśāstre praṣṭāro munayo nāradādayaḥ prāgvaiṣṇavāḥ saugatāśca siddhāntādividastataḥ / kramāttrikārthavijñānacandrotsukitadṛṣṭayaḥ tasmānna gurubhūyastve viśaṅketa kadācana / gurvantararate mūḍhe āgamāntarasevake pratyavāyo ya āmnātaḥ sa itthamiti gṛhyatām / yo yatra śāstre@dhikṛtaḥ sa tatra gururucyate

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v351] There unauthorized, but who, is called that other guru — as seated in that circle toward the other-circle king.

[tal-a13-v352] Own-circle desiring to conquer, fully serving, perishes — so higher-higher knowledge-siddhi desiring, resorting.

[tal-a13-v353] Lower-than-lower teacher goes to destruction — so indeed higher-abiding, from agama, siddhi-desiring.

[tal-a13-v354] Maya-scripture devoted attains destruction — and said in glorious Bliss: action, having resorted, from being.

[tal-a13-v355] Despises that, and in that resorts elsewhere to the fruitless — day by day decreasing thus, is cooked in Raurava and the rest.

[tal-a13-v356] Who upward-path seeking, lower guru-agama abandoned by descent — he blessed, made forward-facing.

[tal-a13-v357] Therefore indeed here, in scriptures, in Shaiva only is determined — toward other-scripture-meanings despairing, the purifying rule.

[tal-a13-v358] Therefore also supreme Shaiva — who elsewhere fallen, he indeed here to be graced; upward and upward, but of the guide, fallen sometimes.

[tal-a13-v359] Therefore indeed, for by omniscient Brahma-Vishnu-and-the-rest in own teaching, not handed down — linga-uprooting and the rest, anything.

[tal-a13-v360] Thus Vishnu-and-the-rest, Shaiva-ultimate-sole knowers — toward some, so initiated; from delusion, dissent resorted.

chunks.l2:
[tal-a13-v361] Seeing such a mind incapable of touching truth among these, even buddhas like Brahma and Vishnu speak thus; therefore this śaktipāta is distinguished by reasoning and scripture.

[tal-a13-v362] Thus this śaktipāta is distinguished by reasoning and scripture.
